title: Support TV episode revision tags
summary: TV rename auto-preview now accepts uploader revision suffixes such as v2 and conservative delimited anime-style bare episode numbers.
reason: Anime release names such as the supplied SubsPlease filename required manual renaming because their episode number was followed by a revision tag.
behavior_before: TV auto-preview rejected bare anime episode forms such as '- 12v2' and did not recognize revision suffixes on SxxEyy or Exx tokens.
behavior_after: TV auto-preview recognizes v-number suffixes as release metadata and accepts only delimited bare anime episode numbers followed by release metadata, an episode-title delimiter, or end of filename.
manual_validation: Focused TV parser and rename bad-case corpus tests passed (13 tests).
The broader rename discovery suite was run; three pre-existing failures outside this packet remain in rename apply/WebView static assertions.
rollback_plan: Revert the parser helper and its regression cases; no source-media files or runtime state are changed by this update.
notes:
Recognize episode revision suffixes and conservative anime-style bare episode tokens.
Cover revision tags, bare anime episode tokens, and false-positive rejection.
Add the SubsPlease revision-tag regression case.
